provenance.note: Defect C31 — the subscription match runs on registerDefendants[0], and defendant[0] is the ADULT. Two defendants in different roles, which is what makes the array-shape operators mean anything.
provenance.operatorDescription: Appends a deep copy of the first element of one array.
provenance.operatorRationale: Nothing in the court-register transform de-duplicates defendants, offences, results, prompts, aliases or counsels; where de-duplication is absent the register must contain the duplicate, and a port that "tidies" it diverges. CAVEAT, recorded per variant: an exact deep copy also duplicates the element's IDENTITY. Two defendants with one masterDefendantId, two offences with one uuid or two results with one judicialResultId is schema-valid (no JSON Schema keyword forbids it) but is not producer output — those variants are PRODUCER_IMPLAUSIBLE. Prompts and aliases carry no identifier and genuinely can repeat, so those variants are IN_CONTRACT and carry the real obligation.
